lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and expanding. Maintain production and tech progression. Consider adding Siege Tanks or other tech units to your composition.
lessons.mistake: Overextending your economy without sufficient army to defend, or neglecting scouting for tech switches or all-ins.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have a clear army lead or when opponent's tech or production changes significantly.
lessons.title: Avoid overextending economy without defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame (around 240-300s) with own heavy production and tech, ground army. Opponent still ground macro with moderate production and light tech.
lessons.why: Your heavy production and tech give you a potential army quality advantage. Expanding further will secure your economy for the long game.

lessons.correction: Continue to strengthen your ground army and increase tech. Maintain production and consider adding more expansions if needed. Keep defenses strong.
lessons.mistake: Falling behind in tech or army upgrades, or over-committing to a single composition without scouting for tech switches.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have a decisive army advantage or when opponent's composition changes significantly.
lessons.title: Avoid falling behind in tech or upgrades
lessons.when: Midgame (around 420-480s) with own heavy ground army, heavy production and tech. Opponent has heavy production and tech, still ground-oriented.
lessons.why: With both players having heavy economies, tech and army quality become decisive. Your Siege Tanks provide a strong defensive and offensive tool.

lessons.correction: Maintain your production and tech, but consider applying light pressure to exploit the opponent's light defense. Continue expanding.
lessons.mistake: Overextending your economy without sufficient army to defend, or neglecting scouting for potential all-ins.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when the opponent's defense strengthens or when you have a clear army lead.
lessons.title: Avoid overextending without scouting for all-ins
lessons.when: Early game (around 180s) with own heavy production and tech, ground army. Opponent similar to N001 but with lighter defense.
lessons.why: Your heavy production can allow you to field a larger army quickly. Pressuring the opponent can disrupt their macro while you continue to develop.
